text: 1、沪指早间窄幅震荡，创业板指走势较弱。农业股反复活跃，万向德农6连板，新赛股份4连板，隆平高科、福建金森等多股涨停。短剧概念延续涨势，芒果超媒、掌阅科技、中广天泽、欢瑞世纪均2连板。大消费板块走强，茂业商业、国芳集团、古井贡酒、西安饮食等涨停。大金融股盘中拉升，华林证券、香溢融通、新力金融直涨停。下跌方面，PCB等算力硬件股下挫，方邦股份、欧科亿跌超10%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超3500股飘红，上午半天成交1.36万亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.03%，深成指跌0.58%，创业板跌0.92%。 2、板块概念方面，农业、短剧、大金融、大消费等板块领涨；算力硬
text_en: 1、Shanghai index traded narrowly in the morning, while ChiNext was weaker. Agricultural stocks remained active, with Wanxiang Denong hitting 6 consecutive limit-ups, Xinsai Shares 4 consecutive limit-ups, and Longping High-Tech, Fujian Jinsen among multiple stocks hitting limit-up. Short-drama concept extended gains, with Mango Excellent Media, Zhangyue Technology, China Broadcasting Tianze, and Huanrui Century each hitting 2 consecutive limit-ups. Major consumer sectors strengthened, with Maoye Commercial, Guofang Group, Gujing Gongjiu, Xi'an Catering among others hitting limit-up. Big financial stocks rallied intraday, with Hualin Securities, Xiangyi Rongtong, and Xinli Financial jumping to limit-up. On the downside, PCB and other computing hardware stocks fell, with Fangbang Shares and Ouke Yi down over 10%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 3,500 stocks rising across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets; morning turnover was 1.36 trillion yuan.
